mq9.alt: An MQ-9 Reaper drone flies low over a sandy desert range.
mq9.caption: An MQ-9 Reaper flies a training mission over the Nevada Test and Training Range, July 15, 2019. MQ-9 aircrew provide dominant, persistent attack and reconnaissance for comabtant commanders and coalition partners across the globe. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class William Rio Rosado)

mq1c.alt: An Army MQ-1C Gray Eagle drone lifts off a runway lined with snow and pine trees.
mq1c.caption: An MQ-1C Gray Eagle, assigned to Delta Company, 25th Aviation takes-off from Ladd Army Airfield April 12, 2016 at Fort Wainwright, Alaska. The Gray Eagle is the most recent edition to U.S. Army Alaska Aviation Task Force and provides USARAK commanders real-world combat assets for training in Alaska. (U.S. Army photo by Staff Sgt. Sean Brady)
mq1c.credit: Staff Sgt. Sean Brady, United States Army Alaska

f15e.alt: An F-15E Strike Eagle flies over hazy blue water.
f15e.caption: An F-15E Strike Eagle aircraft assigned to the 4th Fighter Wing, based at Seymour Johnson Air Force Base, North Carolina, flies just off the coast of Mississippi while participating in Southern Strike 2023, April 19, 2023. Exercise Southern Strike 2023 is a large-scale, joint and international combat exercise, which features agile combat employment, counter insurgency, close air support, non-combatant evacuations, and maritime special operations. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Tech. Sgt. Charles Wesley)
f15e.credit: Tech. Sgt. Charles Wesley, Joint Force Headquarters - Mississippi National Guard

f35a.alt: A dark gray F-35A Lightning II climbs past a bank of white clouds.
f35a.caption: A U.S. Air Force F-35A Lightning II assigned to the 176th Fighter Squadron, Wisconsin Air National Guard, takes off during exercise Resolute Force Pacific 2025 at Palau International Airport, Palau, July 22, 2025. REFORPAC, the largest contingency response exercise ever conducted by the USAF in the Pacific, demonstrates how working alongside allies and partners enhances the ability to respond effectively to challenges in the Indo-Pacific region. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Sarah Williams)
f35a.credit: Staff Sgt. Sarah Williams, Pacific Air Forces

a10.alt: An A-10C Thunderbolt II banks over desert mountains.
a10.caption: A U.S. Air Force A-10C Thunderbolt II aircraft assigned to the 357th Fighter Squadron flies over Southern Arizona, July 28, 2026. For decades, A-10 pilots have trained in Arizona's expansive airspace to maintain combat readiness for global operations. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Samantha Melecio)

kc135.alt: A KC-135 Stratotanker lifts off a runway, landing gear still down.
kc135.caption: A KC-135 Stratotanker performed refueling training at Cannon Air Force Base N.M., June 21, 2021. The KC-135 Stratotanker provides the core area refueling capability for the United States Air Force and has excelled in this role for more than 60 years. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Marcel Williams).
kc135.credit: Senior Airman Marcel Williams, 27th Special Operations Wing

hh60w.alt: An HH-60W Jolly Green II helicopter carries a red firefighting bucket on a line over a rocky hillside.
hh60w.caption: The 305th Rescue Squadron demonstrates using Bambi Buckets with an HH-60W Jolly Green II at Arivaca Lake in Arizona on Dec. 16, 2025. A Bambi Bucket is a specialized, collapsible bucket used by helicopters for aerial firefighting, designed to scoop water from sources like lakes and release it precisely onto wildfires. (Courtesy photo)
hh60w.credit: Staff Sgt. Nicole Mount, 920th Rescue Wing

mc130j.alt: A four-engine MC-130J Commando II flies toward the camera over forested mountains.
mc130j.caption: A 522nd Special Operations Squadron MC-130J Commando II aircraft flies over the skies of New Mexico, Jan. 4, 2012. The 522nd SOS is stationed at Cannon Air Force Base, N.M. and the MC-130J provides in-flight refueling, infiltration/exfiltration and aerial delivery resupply of special operations forces.
mc130j.credit: Senior Airman James Bell, 27th Special Operations Wing

rc135.alt: A white RC-135 Rivet Joint reconnaissance jet takes off past trees.
rc135.caption: A U.S. Air Force RC-135 Rivet Joint, assigned to the 95th Reconnaissance Squadron, takes off the flightline at RAF Mildenhall, ,April 24, 2019. The RC-135 is a reconnaissance aircraft, hosting a myriad of technology behind the cockpit. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Alexandria Lee)
rc135.credit: Senior Airman Alexandria Lee, 100th Air Refueling Wing
